gate_status_note: H100 is a REFERENCE measurement surface only — the formal RTF gate (median > baseline * 1.05 || median > 0.10) stays on the RTX 4090 baseline (docs/perf/cuda-large-v3-baseline.json, M2-14 self-hosted runner + M3-01 5% regression). H100 numbers must NEVER be merged into that file: mixing hardware generations breaks the regression judgment (M4-07 spec T14).

v2.note: FA v2 gate does not fire at decoder-step t_q = 1 by design (FA_V2_MIN_TQ = 16). e2e RTF matches decomposed within noise (mean delta 0.00019, well inside the 0.0021 CV band) = honest inheritance of the RTX 4090 honest-negative on this specific workload.

v3.note: --fa-mode v3 sets VOKRA_CUDA_FA_V3_ENCODER=1 so the encoder self-attention (t_q = 1500, the FA v3 battleground) is exposed e2e; the decoder steady state (t_q = 1) stays below FA_V3_MIN_TQ = 64 by design (FA v2 honest-negative inheritance). Empirical e2e speedup vs decomposed = 5.8% median, 5.5% mean — the encoder-only FA v3 route measurably moves e2e even under decoder-dominated Whisper decoding, a documented positive on Hopper.

e2e_speedup_summary.note: Speedups computed as ratio of RTF numerators (baseline_rtf / target_rtf) — a ratio > 1 means the target runs faster (RTF closer to 0). The FA v2 honest-negative continues on H100 (FA v2 kernel gate does not fire at t_q = 1, so v2 e2e converges to decomposed). FA v3 is the first mode that moves the encoder-side e2e number measurably on this workload.

parity_recorded_max_abs_delta.atol_note: FA_V3_PARITY_ATOL = 0.02 is the tf32 architectural-bound pre-registration (fa_v3.rs rustdoc + ADR M4-07 (d)). Measured causal max |Δ| = 1.206e-2 (60% of atol), non-causal max |Δ| = 1.026e-2 (51% of atol). Both comfortably inside the pre-registered bound = confirmed. Follow-up (M4-07-T18): consider tightening atol to 0.015 after a second independent H100 session confirms the bound holds under different driver / CUDA versions.
